description: R-SQL-1 SQL-DEMAND: At which public boundary does a projected conversion failure (TX id 3) appear: for 'SELECT id, CLng(t) AS v FROM TX' as a snapshot, BOF/EOF/RecordCount are read at open, then rows to EOF, then RecordCount; the same text with only MoveLast/RecordCount/MoveFirst and no field reads; as a dynaset; as forward-only. Then the failure in WHERE, a failing row excluded by WHERE, and the failure only in a GROUP BY's ORDER BY key, with EOF read at open. Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-1-accdb-main opened read-only through ACE DAO; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, Fields Name/Type/Size/SourceTable/SourceField are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
